newsitem.title: USA: Duquesne Beaver Valley nuke resumes output.
newsitem.headline: Duquesne Beaver Valley nuke resumes output.

text.p: Duquesne Light Co said the 833 megawatt (MW) Beaver Valley nuclear power unit 2 in Shippingport, Pa., resumed electricity output Wednesday afternoon following a shutdown for repairs.
"It is back on line, and is climbing toward full power," a company spokesman said Wednesday.
The unit had been operating at about 20 percent of capacity Wednesday morning prior to resuming contributions to the electricity grid.
Beaver Valley 2 was shut Jan 7 to repair an electrical relay problem, and a restart attempt last weekend was abandoned due to a recirculation pump seal problem.
The adjacent 810 MW Beaver Valley unit 1 continued to operate at full output.
Duquesne, a subsidiary of DQE Inc, operates and holds a partial stake in the two Beaver Valley units.
Ohio Edison and Centerior Energy Corp also have interests in the units.
